source_text: Beliefs hold that the procedure curbs excessive sexual desire, thereby ensuring marital fidelity and appeasing deities tied to reproduction and lineage continuity; for instance, uncut females are viewed as susceptible to malevolent spirits that could disrupt communal harmony or agricultural yields linked to fertility cults. [81] [82]
